authorityRules.owner: Native Desktop Owner token derived from verified Portal Owner + PKCE; Redis family and Operator live session revalidated. Never an Agent grant.
authorityRules.agent: Device/Agent/session-bound A/B authorization and local policy remain mandatory.
authorityRules.internalOperator: Private Unix socket, exact verified Owner/session purpose; not a public unauthenticated route.
authorityRules.wall: Same-device Owner/CSRF/origin and signed B checks; not implied by native login.

ownerAuthorize.response: Verified Owner HTML consent -> one-use loopback authorization code

ownerRefresh.response: Same token model; refresh token is atomically consumed, live Owner family rechecked

ownerSession.request: Native-only Authorization Bearer, no browser Origin/cookie

ownerSnapshot.response: Bounded Owner viewport or strict typed Owner-bound page; source/coverage/retention fields required as applicable

operatorOwnerSnapshot.request: Verified native Owner/accountSessionId purpose over private socket, optional typed page
operatorOwnerSnapshot.response: Owner-scoped snapshot/pages from real device/grant registries, PG job ledger and Redis retained sessions

ownerLogout.response: Family revoked, native vault/session cleared by client; no Agent grant mutation

ownerWallTicket.request: Native Owner bearer + exact owned device; mTLS/pinned trusted edge
ownerWallTicket.response: One-use short ticket bound to Owner family/device, delivered by signed device relay
ownerWallTicket.flagsSource: operator-host/desktop-wall-sso-operator-gate-v4.mjs exports DESKTOP_WALL_SSO_OPERATOR_REQUIRED_FLAGS + DESKTOP_WALL_SSO_ISSUER_FLAG_V4; mTLS edge has its separate flag

wallBApprove.request: Authenticated local Owner, CSRF, explicit B, signed pending request/device binding
wallBApprove.response: Durable scoped grant only after all independent consent checks

wallModulesRead.response: Persisted owner-identity partition + monotonically increasing local module revision

wallModulesConfigure.request: Explicit desired state + expectedRevision CAS + Owner/CSRF
wallModulesConfigure.response: Persisted new state or 409; disabling Memory does not delete data

wallCodexStatus.response: Sanitized ChatGPT-plan account, pending code, runtime catalog/selection, actual rate-limit windows and token usage; unavailable/stale remain explicit
wallCodexStatus.authority: Authenticated local Owner; mutation also requires current CSRF; no A/B grant inferred

wallCodexPreferences.response: Validated available model/reasoning saved device-locally for subsequent actual turns; no work is started
wallCodexPreferences.authority: Authenticated local Owner; mutation also requires current CSRF; no A/B grant inferred

wallActivityHistory.response: Retained local events, nextCursor, hasMore, explicit storage-preset coverage; moving UI window never limits total retained jobs
wallActivityHistory.authority: Authenticated local Owner; mutation also requires current CSRF; no A/B grant inferred

wallVideoPage.response: HTML / decoder module / bounded recent video packets; no-store

wallVideoScript.response: HTML / decoder module / bounded recent video packets; no-store

wallVideoLatest.response: HTML / decoder module / bounded recent video packets; no-store

desktopVideoPushInternal.authority: live exact A/B actor grant/device connection and desktop policy; signed enrolled channel for push
desktopVideoPushInternal.response: bounded RAM-only media or metadata, no-store

desktopVideoReadInternal.authority: live exact A/B actor grant/device connection and desktop policy; signed enrolled channel for push
desktopVideoReadInternal.response: bounded RAM-only media or metadata, no-store

nonClaims: A route in source is not DEPLOYED/ENABLED.
A source/CI PASS is not PHYSICAL_PASS.
Snapshot TTL/historyMs are not an immutable audit archive.

desktopDevice.authority: Current native Owner bearer verified against canonical issuer, exact enrolled account/device checked before dispatch and after response; credentials never enter React. Each mutation retains existing confirmation, CAS and signed device channel policy. No remote execution granted by login.
desktopDevice.response: Bounded allowlisted local state or acknowledged operation; unknown outcome never retried automatically. Codex read projects cached account/login, runtime model catalog/selection, reported quota and tokens. codex.preferences validates the current catalog and saves only model/reasoning identifiers; it does not start work.
nativeArguments: expectedAccountId (current verified Owner; checked before effects)

windowsHost.transport: Fixed in-process private CLR host, Windows only
windowsHost.authority: Current OS user and compiled installation/profile boundary; no browser token, URL, path or arbitrary process. Agent remote rights remain independent.
windowsHost.response: Bounded host acknowledgment; read actual state afterward. service-start is idempotent and cannot turn into stop; service-stop retains explicit stop intent. Legacy service toggle remains for compatibility.

rmTaskLifecycle.inputPrecondition: an open owner-bound desktopSessionId; no implicit reopen after close or expiry
rmTaskLifecycle.completionContract: close all task RM scopes in success/failure/cancel cleanup and confirm taskEnded/scopeClosed before final report
rmTaskLifecycle.activityRenews: actual device RM screen/semantic reads and input, not status/general heartbeats or passive Hub push
rmTaskLifecycle.unconfirmedClose: keep row closing, reject input, retry cleanup; never report indicator stopped without confirmation
rmTaskLifecycle.platformBoundary: Agent requires owner-bound scope on all platforms; Windows native validates forwarded private lease and synchronously hides the ended scope indicator

cancelCurrentInput.queuedInput: fenced at cancel; later explicit commands allowed

rmLogicalText.sourceReference: exact SHA256 + device-local Owner read roots + filesystem + remote:read
rmLogicalText.completion: writeId returned after target preflight; poll owned metadata until terminal; verified requires complete same-control readback
rmLogicalText.authorizationRefresh: signed enrolled device-channel desktop-work-authorize; <=1000ms server snapshot + per-chunk current local policy
rmLogicalText.macos: existing short HID+AX/legacy Unicode path; advanced logical requests rejected before input

rmCapture.region: optional integer x/y/width/height in selected screen physical pixels; pinned at attach for scoped frames
rmCapture.cache: copy current pixels every request; compare full cropped pixel hash before JPEG/base64; reuse only matching settings/topology/pixels; clear when final visual scope closes
rmCapture.unchanged: omit JPEG payload at native boundary when Agent-supplied prior encoded SHA matches; never read old pixels on a timer

frameCoordinates.frameSeq: exact latest owned native scoped observation
frameCoordinates.mapping: pixel centers to physical virtual coordinates using observed cropped bounds; no extra DPI factor

rmCapture.benchmarks: isolated same-source capture-only cold allocations vs warm reuse; not prior-release or network/physical comparison

rmVideo.scope: exact existing Windows A/B Agent and RM visual task, local desktop capability
rmVideo.transport: signed device media push and exact actor read, separate RAM-only relay, metadata-only durable capture job
rmVideo.codec: H264 AnnexB independent IDR with SPS/PPS
rmVideo.queue: one in flight per scope, capture lane2 bounded, no autonomous capture
rmVideo.hardware: Media Foundation hardware preference and explicit software fallback; physical acceptance separate
rmVideo.pixels: GPU crop/resize before reduced readback when DXGI succeeds; CPU NV12 and system-memory encoder input explicit, no zero-copy claim
rmVideo.viewer: authenticated same-device Owner reads recent RAM-only already-authorized packets, never captures or renews
rmVideo.close: existing task detach/expiry/revoke disposes video resources; no input replay
